chapterInfo.content:
35
Homeda ho nhyehyɛɛ
1Na Mose hyiaa Israelfoɔ asafo no nyinaa, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ. Nsɛm a AWURADE ahyɛ sɛ monni soɔ nie: 2#Eks 20.8-11; 31.12-17 Nnansia na wɔmfa nyɛ adwuma, na ɛda a ɛtɔ so nson no nyɛ mo homeda kronkron a mode home ma AWURADE; obiara a ɔbɛyɛ mu adwuma no, wɔbɛku no. 3Monnsɔ gya mo tenaberɛ nyinaa homeda.
Mmasoɔ afɔrebɔdeɛ
(Eksodɔs 25.1-9)
4Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ asafo no nyinaa sɛ: Asɛm a AWURADE ahyɛ nie: 5#Eks 25.2 Monyi mmasoɔ afɔrebɔdeɛ wɔ mo mu mmrɛ AWURADE; obiara a n’akoma pɛ no mfa mmasoɔ afɔrebɔdeɛ mmrɛ AWURADE: Sika, dwetɛ ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ, 6ne bibire, asaawa a ɛbere dum, koogyan, ne asaawa fitaa ne mmirekyie nwi. 7Deɛ ɛka ho ne adwennini nwoma a wɔahyɛ no kɔkɔɔ, sukraman nwoma, okuo nnua, 8kanea no ho ngo, nnuhwam a wɔde bɛyɛ sra ngo, ɔhyeɛ aduhwam, 9apopobibire aboɔ, nsisimu aboɔ a wɔde bɛyɛ asɔfotadeɛ ne adaaboɔ no.
Ntomadan no ho nnoɔma
(Eksodɔs 39.32-43)
10Na mo mu akoma mu anyansafoɔ nyinaa mmra mmɛyɛ adeɛ a AWURADE ahyɛ nyinaa, 11#Eks 31.7-11 tenabea no, ntomadan ne ne nkatasoɔ, nkɔtɔkorɔ ne ne ntaaboɔ a ɛsisi ho, ne mmeamu, n’adum ne ne nnyinasoɔ; 12adaka no ne ne mpoma, mpata adwa no ne ntwamutam a ɛtwa mu no, 13ɛpono no ne ne mpoma ne ɛho nnoɔma nyinaa ne kyerɛ paanoo no. 14Bio, kaneadua no ne ɛho nnoɔma ne ne nkanea ne ɛho ngo, 15ne aduhwamhyeɛ bukyia no ne ne mpoma ne sra ngo no ne hyeɛ aduhwam no ne tenabea no ano nkataano no; 16ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no ne ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ ntentan no, ne mpoma ne ɛho nnoɔma nyinaa, kuduo no ne ne ntaaseɛ. 17Deɛ ɛka ho ne adihɔ no ho ntwamutam no, n’adum ne ne nnyinasoɔ ne adihɔ no aboboano nkataano no, 18tenabea no ho mpɛɛwa ne ɛho ntampehoma; 19ɔsom ntadeɛ a wɔde som kronkronbea hɔ, Ɔsɔfoɔ Aaron ntadeɛ kronkron no ne ne mma ntadeɛ a wɔde bɛdi asɔfoɔ no.
Ɔman no afɔrebɔdeɛ
20Na Israelfoɔ asafo no nyinaa firii Mose anim kɔe. 21#Eks 36.3; 1 Be 29.5, 9; 2 Ko 9.7 Na wɔbae, obiara a n’akoma kanyan no ne obiara a ne honhom kaa no, na wɔde AWURADE mmasoɔ afɔrebɔdeɛ baa sɛ wɔmfa nyɛ ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ne ɛho som nnoɔma nyinaa ne ntadeɛ kronkron no. 22Na mmarima ne mmaa nyinaa, dodoɔ a wɔn akoma pɛ nyinaa bae, na wɔde nkapo ne nsomuadeɛ ne mpɛtea ne krakyere ne sika nnwinneɛ ahodoɔ nyinaa bae, na obiara a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔde sika ohim afɔdeɛ brɛ AWURADE, 23ne obiara a ne nsam wɔ bibire ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne koogyan ne asaawa fitaa ne mmirekyie nwi ne adwennini nwoma kɔkɔɔ ne sukraman nwoma no de bae; 24obiara a ɔkura dwetɛ ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ mmasoɔ afɔrebɔdeɛ ma AWURADE de bae, na obiara a ne nsam wɔ okuo nnua a wɔde bɛyɛ ɔsom nnoɔma no biara nso de bae. 25Na mmaa a wɔwɔ nyansa akoma nyinaa de wɔn nsa too asaawa, na wɔde deɛ wɔtoeɛ no bae, bibire ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne koogyan ne asaawa fitaa; 26na mmaa a wɔn akoma pɛ de wɔn nyansa mu nyinaa too mmirekyie nwi asaawa. 27Na mpanimfoɔ no de apopobibire aboɔ ne nsisimu aboɔ a wɔde bɛyɛ asɔfotadeɛ ne adaaboɔ no bae. 28Wɔde nnuhwam ne ngo a wɔde bɛyɛ nkanea ngo ne sra ngo ne ɔhyeɛ aduhwam no nso bae. 29Na Israelfoɔ mu mmarima ne mmaa nyinaa a wɔn akoma pɛ wɔn sɛ wɔmfa nnwuma a AWURADE nam Mose so hyɛɛ sɛ wɔnyɛ no ho biribi mmra no de ayamyi ayɛyɛdeɛ brɛɛ AWURADE.
Ntomadan sie ho adwumayɛfoɔ
(Eksodɔs 31.1-11)
30 # Eks 31.1-6 Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ: Monhwɛ, AWURADE afrɛ Hur ba Uri ba Besalel a ɔfiri Yuda abusuakuo mu, 31na ɔde Nyankopɔn honhom ahyɛ no ma, nyansa, nhunumu, nimdeɛ ne adwinnie nyinaa mu, 32sɛ ɔnni adwini ahodoɔ; sika, dwetɛ ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ, 33ne nsisimu aboɔ mu nkurukyireeɛ, nnuasene ne adwini ahodoɔ, 34na ɔde ahyɛ n’akomam sɛ ɔnkyerɛ ebinom nso. Ɔno ne Ahisamak ba Oholiab a ɔfiri Dan abusuakuo mu no. 35Wɔn na ɔde akoma mu nyansa ahyɛ wɔn ma sɛ wɔnni adwini ahodoɔ nyinaa, sikadwumfoɔ, duadwumfoɔ, ɔnwomfoɔ a ɔdi bibire ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne koogyan ne asaawa fitaa mu adwini ne ntomanwomfoɔ deɛ; wɔn a wɔdi adwini biara, ne wɔn a wɔbɔ wɔn tirim di adwini ahodoɔ.

Na Mose hyiaa Israelfoɔ asafo no nyinaa, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ. Nsɛm a AWURADE ahyɛ sɛ monni soɔ nie: Nnansia na wɔmfa nyɛ adwuma, na ɛda a ɛtɔ so nson no nyɛ mo homeda kronkron a mode home ma AWURADE; obiara a ɔbɛyɛ mu adwuma no, wɔbɛku no. Monnsɔ gya mo tenaberɛ nyinaa homeda.


Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ asafo no nyinaa sɛ: Asɛm a AWURADE ahyɛ nie: Monyi mmasoɔ afɔrebɔdeɛ wɔ mo mu mmrɛ AWURADE; obiara a n’akoma pɛ no mfa mmasoɔ afɔrebɔdeɛ mmrɛ AWURADE: Sika, dwetɛ ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ, ne bibire, asaawa a ɛbere dum, koogyan, ne asaawa fitaa ne mmirekyie nwi. Deɛ ɛka ho ne adwennini nwoma a wɔahyɛ no kɔkɔɔ, sukraman nwoma, okuo nnua, kanea no ho ngo, nnuhwam a wɔde bɛyɛ sra ngo, ɔhyeɛ aduhwam, apopobibire aboɔ, nsisimu aboɔ a wɔde bɛyɛ asɔfotadeɛ ne adaaboɔ no.


Na mo mu akoma mu anyansafoɔ nyinaa mmra mmɛyɛ adeɛ a AWURADE ahyɛ nyinaa, tenabea no, ntomadan ne ne nkatasoɔ, nkɔtɔkorɔ ne ne ntaaboɔ a ɛsisi ho, ne mmeamu, n’adum ne ne nnyinasoɔ; adaka no ne ne mpoma, mpata adwa no ne ntwamutam a ɛtwa mu no, ɛpono no ne ne mpoma ne ɛho nnoɔma nyinaa ne kyerɛ paanoo no. Bio, kaneadua no ne ɛho nnoɔma ne ne nkanea ne ɛho ngo, ne aduhwamhyeɛ bukyia no ne ne mpoma ne sra ngo no ne hyeɛ aduhwam no ne tenabea no ano nkataano no; ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no ne ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ ntentan no, ne mpoma ne ɛho nnoɔma nyinaa, kuduo no ne ne ntaaseɛ. Deɛ ɛka ho ne adihɔ no ho ntwamutam no, n’adum ne ne nnyinasoɔ ne adihɔ no aboboano nkataano no, tenabea no ho mpɛɛwa ne ɛho ntampehoma; ɔsom ntadeɛ a wɔde som kronkronbea hɔ, Ɔsɔfoɔ Aaron ntadeɛ kronkron no ne ne mma ntadeɛ a wɔde bɛdi asɔfoɔ no.

Na Israelfoɔ asafo no nyinaa firii Mose anim kɔe. Na wɔbae, obiara a n’akoma kanyan no ne obiara a ne honhom kaa no, na wɔde AWURADE mmasoɔ afɔrebɔdeɛ baa sɛ wɔmfa nyɛ ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ne ɛho som nnoɔma nyinaa ne ntadeɛ kronkron no. Na mmarima ne mmaa nyinaa, dodoɔ a wɔn akoma pɛ nyinaa bae, na wɔde nkapo ne nsomuadeɛ ne mpɛtea ne krakyere ne sika nnwinneɛ ahodoɔ nyinaa bae, na obiara a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔde sika ohim afɔdeɛ brɛ AWURADE, ne obiara a ne nsam wɔ bibire ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne koogyan ne asaawa fitaa ne mmirekyie nwi ne adwennini nwoma kɔkɔɔ ne sukraman nwoma no de bae; obiara a ɔkura dwetɛ ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ mmasoɔ afɔrebɔdeɛ ma AWURADE de bae, na obiara a ne nsam wɔ okuo nnua a wɔde bɛyɛ ɔsom nnoɔma no biara nso de bae. Na mmaa a wɔwɔ nyansa akoma nyinaa de wɔn nsa too asaawa, na wɔde deɛ wɔtoeɛ no bae, bibire ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne koogyan ne asaawa fitaa; na mmaa a wɔn akoma pɛ de wɔn nyansa mu nyinaa too mmirekyie nwi asaawa. Na mpanimfoɔ no de apopobibire aboɔ ne nsisimu aboɔ a wɔde bɛyɛ asɔfotadeɛ ne adaaboɔ no bae. Wɔde nnuhwam ne ngo a wɔde bɛyɛ nkanea ngo ne sra ngo ne ɔhyeɛ aduhwam no nso bae. Na Israelfoɔ mu mmarima ne mmaa nyinaa a wɔn akoma pɛ wɔn sɛ wɔmfa nnwuma a AWURADE nam Mose so hyɛɛ sɛ wɔnyɛ no ho biribi mmra no de ayamyi ayɛyɛdeɛ brɛɛ AWURADE.


Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ: Monhwɛ, AWURADE afrɛ Hur ba Uri ba Besalel a ɔfiri Yuda abusuakuo mu, na ɔde Nyankopɔn honhom ahyɛ no ma, nyansa, nhunumu, nimdeɛ ne adwinnie nyinaa mu, sɛ ɔnni adwini ahodoɔ; sika, dwetɛ ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ, ne nsisimu aboɔ mu nkurukyireeɛ, nnuasene ne adwini ahodoɔ, na ɔde ahyɛ n’akomam sɛ ɔnkyerɛ ebinom nso. Ɔno ne Ahisamak ba Oholiab a ɔfiri Dan abusuakuo mu no. Wɔn na ɔde akoma mu nyansa ahyɛ wɔn ma sɛ wɔnni adwini ahodoɔ nyinaa, sikadwumfoɔ, duadwumfoɔ, ɔnwomfoɔ a ɔdi bibire ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne koogyan ne asaawa fitaa mu adwini ne ntomanwomfoɔ deɛ; wɔn a wɔdi adwini biara, ne wɔn a wɔbɔ wɔn tirim di adwini ahodoɔ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
